local _b="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function _d(s)
    s=s:gsub("[^".._b.."=]","")
    local t={}
    for i=1,#s,4 do
        local a=_b:find(s:sub(i,i),1,true)
        local b=_b:find(s:sub(i+1,i+1),1,true)
        local c=_b:find(s:sub(i+2,i+2),1,true)
        local d=_b:find(s:sub(i+3,i+3),1,true)
        a=(a and a-1) or 0
        b=(b and b-1) or 0
        c=(c and c-1) or 0
        d=(d and d-1) or 0
        t[#t+1]=string.char(
            math.floor(a*4+b/16),
            ((b%16)*16)+math.floor(c/4),
            ((c%4)*64)+d
        )
    end
    local r=table.concat(t)
    local pad=s:match("(=+)$")
    if pad then r=r:sub(1,#r-#pad) end
    return r
end
